title: WPSS/3955/2018 of SURESH LAL BAIRWAN Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
WPSS No. 3955 of 2018
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Syed Nadim, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Sushil Vashistha, brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand/ respondent nos. 1 to 4.
Mr. Anil Kumar Dabral, Advocate for
respondent no. 5.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner was serving as Head Master in
Government Primary School, Rampur,
Agatsyamuni (Rudraprayag), who was attached in
Government Primary School Agatsyamuni
(Rudraprayag) vide order dated 31.03.2018 passed
by Deputy Education Officer of the concerned
block. The said attachment was made on the
ground that, school in which petitioner was posted
had very few students left. Petitioner joined at
Government Primary School Agatsyamuni on
09.04.2018.
On 09.04.2018, respondent no. 5 was
transferred to the school where petitioner was
attached i.e. Government Primary School,
Agatsyamuni (Rudraprayag) by treating the post of
Head Master in the said school as vacant.
Consequently, on 27.10.2018, District
Education Officer, Primary Education passed an
order directing the petitioner to go back to his
original school by handing over charge to
respondent no. 5. This order dated 27.10.2018
has been challenged in the present writ petition.
A Coordinate Bench of this Court passed
interim order on 29.11.2018 in favour of the
petitioner, on the strength of which petitioner is
still continuing at Agatsyamuni.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits
that since petitioner was attached in Government
Primary School Agatsyamuni on the ground that
there are very few students left in Government
Primary School, Rampur, Agatsyamuni
(Rudraprayag), therefore, there is no justification
for asking the petitioner to go back to the same
school from where he was shifted.
The contention made on behalf of the
petitioner appears to be justified.

Per contra, learned counsel for respondent
no. 5 submits that petitioner was attached at
Agatsyamuni by an Officer, who was not
competent for the purpose, as according to him,
Deputy Block Education Officer is not competent
for making transfer or attachment of Head Master
of Government Primary Schools. He further
submits that respondent no. 5 has been regularly
transferred by the competent authority to
Government Primary School, Agatsyamuni,
therefore, the order of Competent Authority has
the effect of superseding the order passed by the
Deputy Education Officer.
 Without expressing any opinion on the
merits of the claim, this Court thinks that ends of
justice would be met, if the petitioner is permitted
to make representation to the competent
authority, which shall be decided by the
competent authority within some specified time.
 Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of
with liberty to petitioner to make representation to
the District Education Officer, Rudraprayag
regarding his transfer/ posting within two weeks
from today. If such representation is made, the
District Education Officer, Rudraprayag shall
examine the matter and take appropriate decision
by passing a speaking order in accordance with
law, within six weeks from the date of production
of certified copy of this order.
 Till decision on petitionerís representation,
status quo as regards his posting shall be
maintained.
